RULES THAT HOLD THE COUNT AT 10
Hard cap: 10 turns — 7 main questions + 3 probes. A probe is a turn. Never an 11th, however thin an answer is.
Only Q3 (1 probe) and Q4 (2 probes) may probe. Q1, Q2, Q5, Q6, Q7 never spawn a follow-up.
Never re-ask something already volunteered — if Q4's main answer already names the partner and the work, skip probe 1 (conversation ends in 9 turns).
Every branch returns something usable, including every 'No'. No dead turns.
Depth lives in Q4. If the respondent is expansive there, let them talk.
Photo upload is an optional prompt after the close — it is not a turn.
WHAT WAS CUT (was 12 mains + ~25 follow-ups ≈ 30 turns)
Old Q4 'how did you view collaboration BEFORE InvokED' — reconstructing a baseline is expensive and yields thin data. Recovered: Q3 + its probe give magnitude AND substance of the shift directly.
Old Q1/Q2 profile probes — this audience states role and org clearly first time. Recovered: Q1; classify at report time.
Old Q7 probes — scale-then-probe cost 2 turns for one insight. Recovered: Q5 asks scale + 'what changed' together.
Old Q8 'stayed connected with anyone' — overlaps the action block; a connection that led to nothing is low value for an IMPACT report. Recovered: Q4 probe 1 already names the people.
Old Q9 + Q10 merged into Q6; old Q11 + Q12 merged into Q7 (both are consent asks, not insight).
UPGRADE IF REGISTRATION DATA CAN PRE-FILL
Role / org / country / editions are already held for the registrant base. Pre-fill them and Q1 + Q2 collapse into one confirm-tap, freeing 2 turns.

Spend the freed turns on: (a) 'Was that collaboration with someone you met at InvokED, or someone you already knew?' — separates InvokED-CAUSED from InvokED-adjacent, a far stronger claim for the Impact Report. (b) A light network question for anyone who answered No at Q4.
